findings: Isaac ROS 5.0 still builds the stage-2 mask from only the highest-scoring detection in a Detection2DArray, and the pose it publishes is vision_msgs/Detection3DArray. A frame that fails the point-cloud support check is still not published. That output does not carry the other detections source indices.

Lang2Lift (Nguyen et al., arXiv:2508.15427v2) still calls FoundationPose once on the selected mask M_best and couples that 6D pose to the forklift controller. It does not write the other detection indices onto that pose.

Current ifm getPallet still returns every localized pallet, up to 10, on the result the vehicle reads. palletIndex is a template type 0-9, not a Detection2DArray slot. PalletDetection is a header plus pocket PoseStamped fields and has no deferred index list. /diagnostics stays a separate topic from pallet_detection.

Current vision_msgs/Detection3D and geometry_msgs/PoseStamped still have one header and no deferred-index field. Detection2D.id is a cross-message id that may be empty, not the array slot, and Detection2DArray is still an ordered list of proposals from one input. ROS 2 rolling message_filters still matches the pair by header stamps: ExactTime requires the same stamp, and ApproximateTime does not, so both RGB and depth stamps identify the capture.

Rolling diagnostic_msgs/DiagnosticStatus still carries extra fields only as KeyValue strings on the diagnostic channel. No 2024-2026 source found puts the chosen source index and the other class-matched source indices on the pose message the AGV controller reads and repeats those two lists on the failure diagnostic. Wu and Demeester, VISIGRAPP 2026, still rank FoundationPose rotation hypotheses inside one bin; that selection is not a deferred sibling index on the pose.
